prompt: Hibernate XML mapping node attribute dot period format
answer:
In Hibernate XML mappings, `node="."` maps the property or entity data to the **parent XML element**.

Other supported formats include:

- `node="element-name"` — maps to the named XML element
- `node="@attribute-name"` — maps to the named XML attribute
- `node="element-name/@attribute-name"` — maps to the named attribute of the named element

Example:

```xml
<map name="accounts"
     node="."
     embed-xml="true">
```

Here, `node="."` means the `accounts` mapping uses its parent element.
